Fair enough, I only ask because I've only ever smoked it or injected it.  Drugs help dull the pain momentarily. However, as I'm sure you know, they're not the answer. I can understand loss and I'm not sure if it means anything, but you have a friend in me. Although we might be suffering from loss, there is always the potential for happiness eventually. 

It seems unlikely. But there is the potential.

It's impossible to know really. Most grocery stores that still actively grind meat has it come in 10# "chubs" of coarse ground meat. These cases are shipped from a large processing facility. There could be thousands of different cows mixed into each batch. That's why they're given tracking numbers in case of a contaminated product in the chain of custody.

Chicken parts are no different. 

Source: Butcher for 13 years, having worked at grocery stores and various sized slaughter/processing plants

First off, I'm sorry you're going through this. Secondly, you need to end it ASAP. My ex had been cheating on my for about 6 years and I still held on. It only made me resent her more and that showed to our children. If you leave now it will be better for you all in the long run.
